qualification.details: Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical): Postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline (Life Sciences / Health Sciences / Public Health / Clinical Research or allied field) or PhD with 2 years' post-qualification experience. Experience: 5 years' post-qualification experience (or 2 years for PhD). Project Nurse III: Four-year Nursing course from a recognized institution with Nursing Council registration; clinical research, patient follow-up, sample coordination and kidney-transplant/medical ward experience. Project Technical Support III: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant Life Science/Health Science/Allied Discipline with 3 years' post-qualification experience OR postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIMS Hyderabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.nims.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Nizam Institute of Medical Sciences Hyderabad (NIMS Hyderabad) for temporary contractual posts under an ICMR-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NIMS Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical), Project Nurse-III, and Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different designations for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline applications is 09-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for NIMS Hyderabad Recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly via offline mode by sending the filled form through post or courier to the designated address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist-III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Research Scientist-III will receive a consolidated salary of ₹1,01,400 per month including HRA @30%.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Nurse-III post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send my offline application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The Dean, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Panjagutta, Hyderabad - 500082, Telangana, superscribing the envelope as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for applying to these positions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection procedure for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises the shortlisting of applications followed by an interview or a written test.
